// Starts the real `claude` directly (no SDK), writes stdin lines by hand and records everything that comes back.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { CLAUDE, cleanEnv, SCRATCH } from "./realenv.mjs";

export const BASE_ARGS = (extra = [], { model = "claude-sonnet-4-5", maxTurns = 50 } = {}) => [
  "--output-format", "stream-json", "--verbose", "--input-format", "stream-json",
  ...(maxTurns ? [`--max-turns=${maxTurns}`] : []), `--model=${model}`,
  ...extra.filter((a) => a.startsWith("--resume")),
  "--allowedTools=Read,Write,Edit,Bash,Glob,Grep,mcp__tarsee__*", "--tools=Read,Write,Edit,Bash,Glob,Grep,mcp__tarsee__*",
  ...extra.filter((a) => !a.startsWith("--resume")),
  "--permission-mode=bypassPermissions", "--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions", "--include-partial-messages",
];
export const initialize = (systemPrompt = ["VERIFY SYSTEM PROMPT"], id = "init1", extra = {}) => ({ request_id: id, type: "control_request", request: { subtype: "initialize", systemPrompt, systemPromptSnapshot: false, ...extra } });
export const userText = (text) => ({ type: "user", session_id: "", message: { role: "user", content: [{ type: "text", text }] }, parent_tool_use_id: null });

/**
 * opts: args, env (extra over cleanEnv), cwd, initial (objects written at once), onMessage(msg, ctl), closeOnResult
 * (default true), maxMs (kill after), closeStdinAtStart.
 */
export function drive(name, opts) {
  const { args, env = {}, cwd = path.join(SCRATCH, "real", "ws"), initial = [], onMessage = null, closeOnResult = true, maxMs = 40000, closeStdinAtStart = false, rawEnv = null } = opts;
  fs.mkdirSync(cwd, { recursive: true });
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const rel = () => Date.now() - t0;
    const rec = { name, argv: args, cwd, stdin_written: [], stdout: [], non_json_stdout: [], stderr: "", exit: null, notes: [] };
    const child = spawn(CLAUDE, args, { cwd, env: rawEnv ?? cleanEnv(env), stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"], windowsHide: true });
    let stdinOpen = true;
    const ctl = {
      write(obj) { if (!stdinOpen) return; rec.stdin_written.push({ t: rel(), json: obj }); child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify(obj) + "\n"); },
      close() { if (!stdinOpen) return; stdinOpen = false; rec.stdin_written.push({ t: rel(), closed: true }); child.stdin.end(); },
      kill() { rec.notes.push({ t: rel(), note: "killed by the driver" }); child.kill(); },
      note(note) { rec.notes.push({ t: rel(), note }); },
      rel, child,
    };
    child.stdin.on("error", (e) => rec.notes.push({ t: rel(), note: `stdin error ${e.code}` }));
    let buf = "";
    child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8");
    child.stdout.on("data", (d) => {
      buf += d;
      let i;
      while ((i = buf.indexOf("\n")) >= 0) {
        const line = buf.slice(0, i); buf = buf.slice(i + 1);
        if (!line.trim()) continue;
        let msg; try { msg = JSON.parse(line); } catch { rec.non_json_stdout.push({ t: rel(), line }); continue; }
        rec.stdout.push({ t: rel(), json: msg });
        try { onMessage?.(msg, ctl); } catch (e) { rec.notes.push({ t: rel(), note: `onMessage threw ${e.message}` }); }
        if (msg.type === "result" && closeOnResult) ctl.close();
      }
    });
    child.stderr.setEncoding("utf8");
    child.stderr.on("data", (d) => { rec.stderr += d; });
    const cap = setTimeout(() => { rec.notes.push({ t: rel(), note: `still running after ${maxMs} ms: killed by the driver` }); child.kill(); }, maxMs);
    child.on("exit", (code, signal) => { rec.exit = { t: rel(), code, signal }; });
    child.on("close", () => { clearTimeout(cap); if (buf.trim()) rec.non_json_stdout.push({ t: rel(), line: buf, unterminated: true }); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(SCRATCH, "real", "out", `${name}.json`), JSON.stringify(rec, null, 1)); resolve(rec); });
    child.on("error", (e) => { rec.notes.push({ t: rel(), note: `spawn error ${e.message}` }); });
    if (closeStdinAtStart) ctl.close();
    for (const o of initial) ctl.write(o);
  });
}

export const kinds = (rec) => rec.stdout.map((s) => { const m = s.json; return `${s.t}:${m.type}${m.subtype ? "/" + m.subtype : ""}${m.event ? "/" + m.event.type : ""}${m.type === "system" && m.subtype === "session_state_changed" ? "=" + m.state : ""}`; }).join("  ");
